chart_references: The most likely answer is more debt. But from where? The firm already faces a steep wall of maturities: the $40bn bridge loan SoftBank took out to invest in OpenAI matures next March. Selling bonds to Japanese retail investors costs more than it used to. The firm says its level of debt is copacetic, but the “loan-to-value” figure it telegraphs is something of a fantasy, since it ignores an additional $28bn borrowed against stock SoftBank owns in Arm and its Japanese telecoms operation. (The firm is also after a further $10bn to be borrowed against its stake in OpenAI.)
